info.title: CarbonSynq University Local Demo API
info.description: Isolated Node/SQLite demonstration. Not the original Neon API contract. All accounts and factors are demo-only. No AI OCR. Data is scoped to the authenticated university.

post.summary: Sign in with a local demo account

get.summary: Get tenant, campuses, buildings, periods and categories

get.description: Demo factors only; not verified official accounting factors.

post.description: Admin/data-entry only. Same-key same-payload retry is safe; conflicting key or unjustified domain duplicate returns 409.

post.summary: Preview a consumption estimate without writing

get.summary: Get a tenant-owned activity and calculation

patch.summary: Edit a draft or rejected record
patch.description: Original author or administrator. Editing a rejected record returns it to DRAFT.

delete.summary: Delete a draft or rejected record
delete.description: Original author or administrator. Audit retained; linked document returns to review required. A JSON body with version is required.

post.description: Author or admin: DRAFT to SUBMITTED.
Reviewer or admin: SUBMITTED to UNDER_REVIEW.
Reviewer or admin, never the author: UNDER_REVIEW to VERIFIED.
Reviewer or admin: UNDER_REVIEW to REJECTED. Reason required.
Reviewer or admin: VERIFIED to CALCULATED. Already-calculated replay returns the existing calculation.
Admin/data-entry only. PDF, PNG, JPEG or TXT; one file up to 10 MB. Simple text extraction only, no AI OCR. Always requires human review.

get.summary: Get invoice metadata and suggested/reviewed fields

get.description: Authenticated same-tenant evidence download, recorded in the audit trail.

post.summary: Confirm reviewed fields and create an invoice-linked draft
post.description: Admin/data-entry only. Manual human confirmation required; money is not consumption. One document to one activity.

get.summary: Get full activity ledger and calculated-only summary
Download a JSON or CSV report
get.description: Exports all filtered activity statuses. Emissions/factors are filled only for calculated records; summary totals exclude pending activities. Not an audited inventory.

post.description: Administrator only. JSON object body required; pending entries do not prevent locking. API-only control in this demo.

token.description: Opaque bearer token; store in memory, not a URL.

buildingId.description: Optional. Must belong to the selected campus.

scope.description: Optional; derived from category. A supplied inconsistent value is rejected.

quantity.description: Actual consumption, at most 4 decimal places. Never the currency amount.

unit.description: Must match the canonical category unit.

duplicateReason.description: Required with allowDuplicate for a separate matching record.
